expectations.text: A new Slack-related interface (port) is added to server/src/vendor/shared/adapters.ts
expectations.evidence: adapters.ts: new Notifier port and ReviewNotification type.

expectations.text: The concrete implementation (the code that performs the HTTP call to the webhook) lives in a new file in its own new directory under server/src/adapters/<name>/
expectations.evidence: Concrete code in server/src/adapters/slack/webhook.ts (contains the fetch).

expectations.text: A mock implementation of the new port is added to server/src/adapters/mocks.ts
container.ts registers the new adapter with a getter and a ContainerOverrides entry
expectations.evidence: container.ts: ContainerOverrides.notifier plus get notifier() getter.

expectations.text: ReviewService reaches the notifier only through this.container and contains no fetch/axios/Slack SDK call or import of the concrete adapter
expectations.evidence: ReviewService calls this.container.notifier.notifyReviewCompleted(...); no fetch or concrete adapter import.
